summary: Implemented standalone ferby-clipboard-import-core crate with injectable ClipboardImageReader, ArboardClipboardReader adapter, strict RGBA dimension/pixel/length validation, straight-alpha PNG encoding, and 3 fake-reader unit tests. Proposed C08 integration: link ferby-clipboard-import-core in src-tauri/Cargo.toml and expose a main-window-only import_clipboard_image command.
risks: Automated tests use FakeClipboardReader only; real macOS pasteboard integration and Tauri command wiring belong to Codex C08.
